paite: Paula, sawltak-mihingte, sawl khiak hi louin, mihing vanga leng hi sam lou, Jesu Kris leh misi laka pata kaithoupa, Pa Pathian vangin ahi jaw-
english: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

paite: Leh ka kianga unau om tengtengten, Galatia gama saptuamte kiangah:
english: and all the brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

paite: Pa Pathian leh i Toupa Jesu Kris kianga kipan hehpihna leh lemna na kiang uah om hen;
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Amah tuh, i Pathian leh a Pa deihdanin, tulai khovel gilou tak laka a honsuahtak sak theihna dingin i khelhnate adingin amah a kipeta hi;
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

paite: Pathian kiangah thupina khantawnin om hen. Amen.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Kris hehpihna jiaka nou honsampa huchi guiha tanchin hoih tuam lama na kisuansan uh lamdang ka sa hi;
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;

paite: Tanchin hoih dang a om ahi keia; noumau honhihbuaiin, Kris Tanchin Hoih hihlamdan ut kuate hiam a na om uh ahi.
english: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

paite: Himahleh, koumau hiam aw, van akipana hongsuk angel nangawn hiam inleng, tanchin hoih na kiang ua ka gensa pen louhngal uh tanchin hoih dang himhim honnahilhta a om uleh, hamse lohin om hen.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

paite: Tumaa ka gen bangmah un, tua gen nawn ding ka hi. Tanchin Hoih na muh pen louhngal uh, tanchin hoih dang kua peuhin nou a honhilh leh, hamse lohin om hen.
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

paite: Ahihleh, tuin mihing deihsakna hia ka zon Pathian-a? Ahihkeileh, mihing ahi maw lungtaisak ta tup? Mihing nana lungtaisak lai hitaleng, Kris sikha ka hi kei ding.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

paite: Huchiin, unaute aw, ka tanchin hoih genpen mihing lam thu ahi kei chih ka hontheisak hi.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

paite: Mihing kianga kipana ka muh leng ahi kei, mi honhilh leng ka hi sam kei, Jesu Kris kilakna jiaka mu ka hi zo ngala.
english: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

paite: Judate sabiakdan ah, nidanglai ka omdan na thei khinta ngal ua, huchia Pathian saptuamte nakpi taka sawiin ka hihbuai ngitngeta:
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

paite: Huan, ka pipute thusiah tunga Phatuam ka ngaihtuan khol jiakin Judate sabiakdan lamah leng ka chite laka ka khanvual tampite ka na khengta hi.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

paite: Huan, ka nu gilsung akipana honhihtuampa leh a hehpihna jiaka honsampa Pathianin,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,

paite: Jentelte laka a tanchin hoih ka hilh theihna dingin a Tapa tuh lunghi taka keimaha a kilaksak laiin, sa leh sisan toh kidong louin,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

paite: Sawltak ka hih maa sawltak na nahisate kiangah Jerusalem khuaa vahohtou tuan louin, Arabia gamah ka pai mang pah ngal jaw a; huan, Damaska khua ah ka kik nawnta hi.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

paite: Huan, kum thum a bei nungin Kifa veh dingin Jerusalem khuaah ka vahoh tou a, a kiangah ni sawm leh ni nga ka tama.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

paite: Sawltak dangte bel Toupa unau Jakob kia loungal, kuamah ka mu kei hi.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.

paite: (Ngai him dih ua! na kiang ua thu ka gelhte khawng Pathian mitmuh ah leng ka juau kei hi. )
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

paite: Huai nungin Suria leh Silisia gam khawngah ka hongpai hi.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

paite: Huan, Judia gama saptuamte Krisa omte meltheih ka hi nai kei lailaia,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

paite: Tumalama honsawipan tumaa khatvei ginna thu a hihbuai tuh tuin a gen zota, chih mi gen kia a ja uhi.Huan, keimah jiakin Pathian a hihlianta uhi.
english: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

paite: Huan, keimah jiakin Pathian a hihlianta uhi.
english: And they glorified God in me.
